declarations.bibleVerseText: I will pour out my Spirit on your offspring, and my blessing on your descendants.

declarations.text: The promise is for me and my children and generations to come.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The promise is for you and your children and for all who are far off.

declarations.text: I teach God's words diligently to my children throughout the day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Impress them on your children. Talk about them when you sit at home and when you walk along the road.

declarations.text: My children rise up and call me blessed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Her children arise and call her blessed.

declarations.text: I parent with patience, love, and godly wisdom.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Love is patient, love is kind.

declarations.text: My household and I serve the Lord faithfully.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But as for me and my household, we will serve the Lord.

declarations.text: I discipline my children in love for their good.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord disciplines the one he loves.

declarations.text: My children walk in truth and bring me great joy.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have no greater joy than to hear that my children are walking in the truth.

declarations.text: Goodness and mercy follow my children all their days.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life.

declarations.text: My children are mighty in the land and blessed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Their children will be mighty in the land; the generation of the upright will be blessed.

declarations.text: I leave an inheritance of faith and blessing to my children.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A good person leaves an inheritance for their children's children.

declarations.text: The favor of the Lord rests upon my children.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let the favor of the Lord our God rest on us.

declarations.text: I pray without ceasing for my children's salvation and growth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Pray continually.

declarations.text: My children are protected by God's angels continually.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

declarations.text: Wisdom and stature and favor increase in my children.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

declarations.text: I model Christ to my children in word and deed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Follow my example, as I follow the example of Christ.

declarations.text: A friend loves at all times and I am that faithful friend.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A friend loves at all times, and a brother is born for a time of adversity.

declarations.text: I have friends who stick closer than a brother.
declarations.bibleVerseText: There is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

declarations.text: Iron sharpens iron and my friendships make me better.
declarations.bibleVerseText: As iron sharpens iron, so one person sharpens another.

declarations.text: I lay down my life for my friends as Christ did for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down one's life for one's friends.

declarations.text: I am a friend of God and walk in His ways.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You are my friends if you do what I command.

declarations.text: Two are better than one and I value godly friendships.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Two are better than one, because they have a good return for their labor.

declarations.text: I choose my friends wisely and walk with the wise.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Walk with the wise and become wise, for a companion of fools suffers harm.

declarations.text: My friendships are marked by love, loyalty, and truth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Wounds from a friend can be trusted.

declarations.text: I encourage my friends and build them up in faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore encourage one another and build each other up.

declarations.text: I bear my friends' burdens and fulfill the law of Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Carry each other's burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.

declarations.text: My friendships are seasoned with grace and forgiveness.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Be kind and compassionate to one another, forgiving each other.

declarations.text: I am quick to listen and slow to speak in friendships.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak and slow to become angry.

declarations.text: The sweetness of friendship brings joy to my soul.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart, and the pleasantness of a friend springs from their heartfelt advice.

declarations.text: I am loyal and my friendships endure through all seasons.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A friend loves at all times.

declarations.text: My friends and I spur one another on to love and good deeds.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And let us consider how we may spur one another on toward love and good deeds.

declarations.text: I am trustworthy and my friends can confide in me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gossip betrays a confidence, but a trustworthy person keeps a secret.

declarations.text: My friendships reflect the love of Christ to the world.
declarations.bibleVerseText: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.

declarations.text: I rejoice with those who rejoice and weep with those who weep.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Rejoice with those who rejoice; mourn with those who mourn.

declarations.text: Unity and harmony mark my friendships in Christ.
declarations.bibleVerseText: How good and pleasant it is when God's people live together in unity!

declarations.text: I am generous with my friends and share freely.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Do not forget to do good and to share with others.

declarations.text: The Lord is my shield and protector all around me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But you, Lord, are a shield around me, my glory, the One who lifts my head high.

declarations.text: I dwell in the secret place of the Most High under His shadow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever dwells in the shelter of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

declarations.text: No evil befalls me and no plague comes near my dwelling.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No harm will overtake you, no disaster will come near your tent.

declarations.text: Angels are given charge over me to keep me in all my ways.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

declarations.text: The angel of the Lord encamps around me and delivers me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them.

declarations.text: God is my refuge and strength and very present help.
declarations.bibleVerseText: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.

declarations.text: The name of the Lord is my strong tower and I am safe.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The name of the Lord is a fortified tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.

declarations.text: I am hidden in the hollow of His hand.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He has hidden me in the shadow of his hand.

declarations.text: The Lord goes before me and is my rear guard.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will go before you, the God of Israel will be your rear guard.

declarations.text: I am kept by the power of God through faith.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Who through faith are shielded by God's power.

declarations.text: No weapon formed against me prospers under God's protection.
declarations.bibleVerseText: No weapon forged against you will prevail.

declarations.text: The Lord is faithful and He establishes and guards me from evil.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But the Lord is faithful, and he will strengthen you and protect you from the evil one.

declarations.text: I am the apple of His eye and He hides me in His wings.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Keep me as the apple of your eye; hide me in the shadow of your wings.

declarations.text: God delivers me from every trap and deadly pestilence.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely he will save you from the fowler's snare and from the deadly pestilence.

declarations.text: A thousand may fall at my side but it shall not come near me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A thousand may fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, but it will not come near you.

declarations.text: God is my fortress and in Him I take refuge.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He is my loving God and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer, my shield, in whom I take refuge.

declarations.text: The Lord preserves me from all evil and keeps my soul.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will keep you from all harm—he will watch over your life.

declarations.text: I am surrounded by God's favor as with a shield.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely, Lord, you bless the righteous; you surround them with your favor as with a shield.

declarations.text: The Lord watches over my coming and going forevermore.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will watch over your coming and going both now and forevermore.

declarations.text: I abide under the protection of the Almighty.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will say of the Lord, 'He is my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.'

declarations.text: I am highly favored and the Lord is with me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.

declarations.text: God's favor surrounds me like a shield every day.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you bless the righteous, O Lord; you cover him with favor as with a shield.

declarations.text: I have favor with God and man increasing daily.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And Jesus grew in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and man.

declarations.text: The favor of the Lord makes me rich without sorrow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: I am blessed and highly favored in the beloved.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To the praise of the glory of his grace, wherein he hath made us accepted in the beloved.

declarations.text: Doors open for me that no man can shut.
declarations.bibleVerseText: What he opens no one can shut, and what he shuts no one can open.

declarations.text: I find favor in the sight of all who see me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: When the Lord takes pleasure in anyone's way, he causes their enemies to make peace with them.

declarations.text: Good understanding gives me favor and success.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Good understanding gives favor and good success.

declarations.text: The Lord's favor rests upon me for a lifetime.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For his anger lasts only a moment, but his favor lasts a lifetime.

declarations.text: I receive preferential treatment because of God's favor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you, Lord, will bless the righteous; with favor you will surround him like a shield.

declarations.text: Favor causes my mountains to stand strong.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Lord, when you favored me, you made my royal mountain stand firm.

declarations.text: I walk in a year of the Lord's favor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: To proclaim the year of the Lord's favor.

declarations.text: Unexpected favor comes from unexpected places.
declarations.bibleVerseText: He caused them to be pitied by all who held them captive.

declarations.text: The Lord delights in me and shows me His favor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If the Lord delights in us, then he will bring us into this land and give it to us.

declarations.text: Divine connections come my way through God's favor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The king's heart is a stream of water in the hand of the Lord; he turns it wherever he will.

declarations.text: I am remembered and favored with divine visitation.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You have granted me life and favor, and your visitation has preserved my spirit.

declarations.text: Favor brings promotion and positions me for purpose.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For promotion comes neither from the east nor from the west nor from the south. But God is the Judge: He puts down one and exalts another.

declarations.text: I am crowned with glory and honor through His favor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You have crowned them with glory and honor.

declarations.text: Goodness and mercy follow me because of favor.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life.

declarations.text: The favor on my life cannot be earned or explained.
declarations.bibleVerseText: It does not, therefore, depend on human desire or effort, but on God's mercy.

declarations.text: My God supplies all my needs according to His riches in glory.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of his glory in Christ Jesus.

declarations.text: I am blessed to be a blessing to nations.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, and you will be a blessing.

declarations.text: Wealth and riches are in my house and my righteousness endures.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Wealth and riches are in their houses, and their righteousness endures forever.

declarations.text: I have power to get wealth to establish God's covenant.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you the ability to produce wealth.

declarations.text: I lend to many nations and borrow from none.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will lend to many nations but will borrow from none.

declarations.text: The blessing of the Lord makes me rich without sorrow.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The blessing of the Lord brings wealth, without painful toil for it.

declarations.text: I prosper and am in health even as my soul prospers.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.

declarations.text: I am the head and not the tail, above and not beneath.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The Lord will make you the head, not the tail.

declarations.text: Good measure pressed down and running over is given to me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Give, and it will be given to you. A good measure, pressed down, shaken together and running over.

declarations.text: I seek first the kingdom and all things are added to me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.

declarations.text: I have abundance for every good work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And God is able to bless you abundantly, so that in all things at all times, having all that you need, you will abound in every good work.

declarations.text: I sow generously and reap generously.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly, and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.

declarations.text: The wealth of the sinner is laid up for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A sinner's wealth is stored up for the righteous.

declarations.text: I am enriched in everything for all liberality.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will be enriched in every way so that you can be generous on every occasion.

declarations.text: My cup runs over with God's abundance.
declarations.bibleVerseText: My cup overflows.

declarations.text: I have all sufficiency in all things at all times.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, so that having all sufficiency in all things at all times.

declarations.text: Windows of heaven are open over my life pouring out blessings.
declarations.bibleVerseText: See if I will not throw open the floodgates of heaven and pour out so much blessing that there will not be room enough to store it.

declarations.text: I am a cheerful giver and God loves me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

declarations.text: Christ became poor that through His poverty I might be rich.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sake he became poor, so that you through his poverty might become rich.

declarations.text: I eat the good of the land and enjoy its wealth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: If you are willing and obedient, you will eat the good things of the land.

declarations.text: I work heartily as unto the Lord and not unto men.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for human masters.

declarations.text: My work is established and blessed by the Lord.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.

declarations.text: I am diligent and my hands bring wealth.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Diligent hands will rule, but laziness ends in forced labor.

declarations.text: The Lord establishes the work of my hands.
declarations.bibleVerseText: May the favor of the Lord our God rest on us; establish the work of our hands for us.

declarations.text: I find favor and success in all my endeavors.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let them grant you according to your heart's desire and fulfill all your plans.

declarations.text: My gift makes room for me and brings me before great people.
declarations.bibleVerseText: A gift opens the way and ushers the giver into the presence of the great.

declarations.text: I prosper in all I do and wherever I go.
declarations.bibleVerseText: That you may be careful to do everything written in it. Then you will be prosperous and successful.

declarations.text: Excellence is my standard and I do all things well.
declarations.bibleVerseText: And whatever you do, whether in word or deed, do it all in the name of the Lord Jesus.

declarations.text: My work brings glory to God and blessing to others.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In the same way, let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.

declarations.text: I am faithful in little and ruler over much.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever is faithful in very little is also faithful in much.

declarations.text: Promotion comes from the Lord and He exalts me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For exaltation comes neither from the east nor from the west nor from the south. But God is the Judge: He puts down one, and exalts another.

declarations.text: I use my talents wisely and they multiply.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things.

declarations.text: My labor in the Lord is never in vain.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Therefore, my dear brothers and sisters, stand firm. Let nothing move you. Always give yourselves fully to the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

declarations.text: I work with my hands and the work of my hands is blessed.
declarations.bibleVerseText: You will eat the fruit of your labor; blessings and prosperity will be yours.

declarations.text: Creative ideas and divine solutions flow to me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: I have filled him with the Spirit of God, with wisdom, with understanding, with knowledge and with all kinds of skills.

declarations.text: I serve with integrity and my righteousness goes before me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Whoever walks in integrity walks securely.

declarations.text: I am equipped for every good work God prepared for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: For we are God's handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works, which God prepared in advance for us to do.

declarations.text: My steps are ordered and opportunities align for me.
declarations.bibleVerseText: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord.

declarations.text: I rest in God's provision while being diligent in my work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for food to eat—for he grants sleep to those he loves.

declarations.text: I reap a harvest from everything I sow in my work.
declarations.bibleVerseText: Let us not become weary in doing good, for at the proper time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
